scoring_justification: TB parameters and DOS features are derived from a full DFT calculation and band-fitting procedure that cannot be recomputed in the verifier sandbox, so a result-level compare against paper gold values with tolerances accounting for DFT code differences is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for TB parameters and DOS feature bounds
hidden_assets.source_provenance: from the paper's reported TB fitted parameters (ppσ 0.40, ppπ -0.13, pdσ -1.73, pdπ 0.78, bare energy 0.4) and DOS feature energy ranges as described in text (A: -0.5 to 2.5, B: -1.5 to -0.5, C: -3.5 to -1.5, D: -7.0 to -3.8).
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from paper's text and table; no fabrication.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values match the paper's published quantities for LaNiO3.

outputs.description: Energy bounds of the four characteristic DOS features for LaNiO3.
Fitted Slater-Koster hopping parameters and the bare energy difference Δ = ε_d − ε_p.

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares reported energy windows and TB parameters to hidden reference values with tolerances that account for DFT-code differences. Structural checks (sign and energy ordering) are also applied.
